Elias opened the valve. The rush of water filled the tank, then cut off with a definitive click. Silence returned to the room, save for the distant hum of the refrigerator.

"It stopped," Elias said, relief evident in his shoulders. "Thanks, Marcus."

"No problem," Marcus replied, clapping his hands together. "Glad we got it sorted. By the way, ravens, *Corvus corax*, engage in mobbing behavior, calling out predators to drive them away from their territory. Very social creatures. Have a good night, Elias."

Elias watched him walk out, shaking his head slightly before closing the bathroom door.
